subject: gk
question: In March 2024, Gyanesh Kumar, a 1988-batch Kerala cadre officer of the Indian Administrative Service, joined which of the following departments of the Indian Government?

options.text: Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Election Commission of India (ECI)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Gyanesh Kumar, a 1988-batch Kerala cadre officer of the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), was appointed as the **Election Commissioner of India** in March 2024.
 
• The Election Commission of India (ECI) is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering elections in India.
 
• The ECI ensures free, fair, and impartial elections for the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, state legislatures, and the offices of the President and Vice President.
 
• The Election Commission of India was established on **25th January 1950**, and this date is celebrated annually as **National Voters' Day**.
 
• The appointment of Election Commissioners is made by the **President of India**, and they serve until the age of 65 years or for a tenure of six years, whichever is earlier.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Election Commission of India (ECI):**

 
 
• The ECI is a three-member body, comprising the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) and two other Election Commissioners.
 
• The decisions of the ECI are made by a majority vote among the three members.
 
• The ECI has the responsibility to ensure the Model Code of Conduct (MCC) is followed during elections.
 
• Under Article 324 of the Indian Constitution, the ECI has the authority to supervise, direct, and control the entire election process.
 
 
 
• **Constitutional Provisions:**
 
 
• Article 324: Provides for the establishment of the Election Commission.
 
• Article 325: Prohibits discrimination in the preparation of electoral rolls on grounds of religion, race, caste, or sex.
 
• Article 326: Grants universal adult suffrage, allowing all citizens of 18 years and above to vote.
 
 
 
• **Chief Election Commissioner (CEC):**
 
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner is the head of the ECI.
 
• The CEC is appointed by the President of India and can be removed only through impeachment by Parliament, similar to the removal process of a Supreme Court judge.
 
 
 
• **Recent Election Reforms:**
 
 
• Introduction of Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail (VVPAT) with Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs) for greater transparency.
 
• Use of digital technology, including the **cVIGIL app**, to report violations of the MCC.
 
• Facilitation of remote voting for migrant workers, proposed through blockchain technology.
